answer.ruling: A player rules a clearing with more total warriors plus buildings than each other player. Ordinary ties mean nobody rules. Tokens and pawns do not count. Eyrie win ties for most if they have at least one Eyrie piece there. Vagabond cannot rule or stop another player ruling.

answer.ruling: Move any positive number of your warriors/pawns from one clearing along a linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination or both, rechecking rule each move. Same pieces may move repeatedly, including multiple moves in one action. Rivers are not paths unless an effect says so.
answer.evidence: Actions > Shared movement, crafting and battle; Move (4.2)

answers.evidence: Actions > Shared movement, crafting and battle; Move (4.2)

answer.ruling: Choose a clearing with your warriors or pawn and an enemy defender; no rule requirement. Defender may play matching ambush (birds wild); attacker may foil with matching ambush. Defender card is discarded; foiled ambush causes no hits, otherwise defender deals 2 immediate hits, uncapped by warriors, then discards; if no attacking warriors/pawns remain, battle ends. Resolve before-roll effects (attacker orders simultaneous effects), roll (higher die attacker, lower defender, equal dice equal; each side capped by its own warriors; Alliance defense reverses dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords), resolve after-roll effects (attacker chooses order), then count: add extra hits, subtract ignored hits, and attacker gets +1 defenseless hit if defender has no warriors (Vagabond instead has no undamaged swords). Each side removes opposing pieces for its hits; hit recipient chooses removal order but must remove all warriors before buildings/tokens, and orders its removal-trigger effects. Both sides deal counted hits even if warriors were removed after rolling. Remover scores 1 VP per enemy building/token, while defending too; warriors give no ordinary VP. Vagabond hits damage items.

answer.part: craft cost; reuse; absent item; duplicate persistent effect
answer.ruling: Bottom-left icons define cost. Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance activate one matching-suit workshop/roost/sympathy for each icon, each piece once per turn. Vagabond exhausts one face-up undamaged hammer per icon and current clearing must match every icon; may activate repeatedly. Three-color ? accepts any suit. Item card cannot be crafted unless corresponding item token is in map supply. Cannot craft an identical persistent effect already in play.

answer.ruling: In own Daylight at 10+ VP activate dominance from hand into play; remove score marker and stop VP scoring. At start of own Birdsong, win by ruling 3 clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit, or for bird dominance 2 diagonally opposite corner clearings. Activation cannot be removed or replaced.

When dominance would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight spend a matching card to take an available dominance into hand; bird dominance remains bird and requires a bird payment (bird can pay for non-bird). Taking does not activate it; taking and activation are separate and require no faction action allowance.

With two players remove all four dominance cards; shuffle shared deck and each draw 3. Cover four R building slots with ruins. Map supply: 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins. Only if Vagabond present, hide one R-marked bag, boot, hammer, sword beneath separate ruins; shuffle stacks and return to R slots; without Vagabond ruins are empty. Setup factions in Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond letter order.

answers.evidence: Setup > Standard Setup (steps 3–7), Hidden ruin items

answer.ruling: Only Marquise may place pieces in Keep clearing; others may move pieces there. If Keep removed it cannot be placed again. When any number Marquise warriors are removed from a clearing, Marquise may spend one card matching that clearing to place those warriors in Keep clearing instead of supply, including removals outside battle. Without Keep there is no hospital destination.

First craft with workshops. Then up to 3 actions plus 1 per bird card spent outside an action, any order/number except Recruit once per turn. March is up to 2 moves in one compound action, with same or different warriors; cannot interrupt between moves to spend bird or take another action. Recruit places 1 warrior at each recruiter, only once/turn. Overwork spends a card matching sawmill clearing to place 1 wood there.

Choose a clearing you rule with open slot and building type; take leftmost building of that type. Pay column-top cost by removing required wood from target clearing or other ruled clearings connected to it by an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place building and score VP shown on uncovered space. Requires full wood cost, building available and legal slot.

In order: Emergency Orders draw 1 if hand empty; add 1 or 2 hand cards to any Decree columns, at most 1 bird; if no roosts on map, New Roost places 1 roost and 3 warriors in a clearing with fewest warriors where all pieces can be placed.

Craft with roosts first, then every Decree card by columns Recruit, Move, Battle, Build; freely order cards within a column. Bird is wild. Suit location: Recruit clearing with roost; Move origin; Battle clearing of battle; Build target. For each card Recruit 1 warrior at chosen matching roost (Charismatic 2), Move at least 1 warrior obeying path/rule, initiate battle with Eyrie warriors and enemy, or place 1 roost in a ruled matching clearing with open slot and no roost already there. An uncompletable action causes immediate Turmoil.

answer.ruling: Lose 1 VP per bird Decree card including both Viziers; discard all Decree cards except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose face-up replacement (if none, turn all face up first); retuck Viziers in new leader columns. Daylight ends, then normal Evening still scores roost track, draws 1 plus uncovered bonuses, discards to 5. Map warriors/buildings remain.

Another player removing sympathy or moving any warriors into sympathetic clearing adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters; a moved group costs one card per affected move, not per warrior. If no matching card including bird, show hand to Alliance; Alliance draws one deck card to Supporters. If full, incoming Outrage card is discarded; payment/no-match draw still occurs.

All Revolts must occur before any Spread Sympathy; either may repeat. Spent supporters for either must match target clearing (birds wild). Revolt: sympathetic clearing without base, matching a base still on board; spend 2 matching supporters; remove all enemy pieces, score 1 VP per building/token removed, place matching base, place warriors equal to matching-suit sympathetic clearings including target and 1 in Officers; enemy Vagabond instead damages 3 items. Spread: unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy, or any clearing if no sympathy; pay cost shown above next sympathy token plus 1 matching supporter if one other player has at least 3 warriors there (Martial Law); place token and score uncovered VP.

Train during Daylight by spending a hand card matching a clearing with base, placing 1 supply warrior in Officers; Supporters cannot pay. Each officer permits 1 Evening operation and is not consumed. Organize is an Evening operation: remove 1 Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing, place sympathy there and score uncovered VP; no supporters, adjacency or Martial Law cost, but legal token placement is required. When base removed, discard supporters matching its clearing including birds; remove half officers rounded up; if no bases remain, discard supporters above 5.

answer.ruling: Birdsong Refresh: for each tea already face up on Refresh track, flip 2 exhausted items face up, then 3 more; newly refreshed tea adds nothing this step. Optional Slip moves to adjacent clearing/forest without boot, even into hostile warriors; ignores effects preventing movement out. Normal Daylight Move exhausts 1 boot plus 1 extra if destination has any hostile faction warriors; ignores rule, cannot enter forest, and from forest may move only to adjacent clearing. Evening in forest Rest returns damaged items to Satchel face up; does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Always draw 1 plus face-up track coins even after Rest.

Explore exhaust torch in ruin clearing, take hidden item face up into Satchel/track and score 1 VP if item taken; remove ruin when last item taken. Quest in matching clearing: exhaust its 2 listed items, complete it, choose VP equal to completed matching quests including this one or draw 2 cards, then draw replacement quest. Repair exhaust hammer and move 1 damaged item to Satchel keeping its face; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if space.

Removing one warrior of a non-Hostile faction immediately makes it Hostile (except special allied-warrior battle-loss timing). In battle on Vagabond own turn, +1 VP per hostile piece removed, except warrior that first caused Hostility; hostile building/token therefore earns ordinary 1 + Infamy 1. Aid cannot move marker out of Hostile, though may still take crafted item. Strike exhausts crossbow to remove one enemy warrior; only if that enemy has no warriors there may remove another faction piece. Strike gives no Infamy.

With 4+ players, Vagabond in own Daylight at 10+ VP activates dominance to coalition with player not already in coalition, lowest VP among players other than Vagabond (choose among ties). Places score marker on partner board and stops scoring; if partner wins, including by dominance, Vagabond also wins. Hostile partner becomes Indifferent.

Card overrides Law; Law overrides Learning to Play; faction rule takes precedence over incompatible general rule. “Cannot” is absolute unless explicitly overridden; ordinary card override is not specified as exception to this rule.

If simultaneous effects lack clear order or decision maker, current player chooses; for battle effects at same timing, attacker chooses order. Marquise March’s two moves are one compound action and cannot be interrupted to spend bird or take another action.

At-start effects precede other effects in phase; at-end effects follow all phase effects before next phase. Once last step of a turn begins, no other actions except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions.

Hand size public, hand contents private; reveal/show only when explicitly instructed. Face-up piles searchable/inspectable; deck cannot be inspected. Deals are nonbinding, cards transfer only as instructed, and actions require no consent.

When shared deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into a new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, even multiple same-suit payments. For prompted non-bird suit give/discard, birds count as that suit; explicit bird requirement cannot be paid with non-bird.

Pieces finite; no proxies. If unable to place all prompted pieces, place maximum possible, cannot voluntarily place fewer. Shortage never waives costs/prerequisites or Eyrie obligation to complete Decree actions.

answer.ruling: Placement normally from supply or leftmost track; removal to supply or rightmost empty track. Removed items permanently leave game. For simultaneous removal, remove all pieces before triggering removal effects.

answer.ruling: Resolve forced action as if affected player chose it, retaining their abilities and restrictions; forced player makes battle decisions.
Replacement requires both removal and placement possible; Keep placement ban cannot be bypassed by replacing enemy piece. Swap ignores move/place restrictions.
If multiple players reach 30 simultaneously, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.

Forest adjacency is determined by printed paths/clearings: forests adjacent to clearings touching them without crossing a path and to forests separated by one path; Winter river also divides forests. Fall has no special rules.

Supply 25 warriors and 8 wood. Put Keep in any corner. Place 1 warrior in every clearing except diagonally opposite corner. Put one each sawmill, workshop, recruiter among Keep clearing and adjacent clearings, any combination respecting slots. Remaining five buildings of each type go on tracks right-to-left, leaving leftmost space empty.

Supply 20 warriors. Put 1 roost and 6 warriors in corner not another player’s starting corner, diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible. Choose leader and leave others face up; tuck two bird Viziers in that leader’s listed columns. Fill roost track with other 6 roosts from right to left.
Supply 10 warriors; place 3 bases in matching board spaces and 10 sympathy on track. Draw 3 additional face-down cards to Supporters, separate from 3-card hand. Start with no map pieces or officers.

Choose Thief/Tinker/Ranger, place pawn in any forest, shuffle quests and display 3 face up. Other factions’ relationship markers start Indifferent. Take character’s S-marked starting items: tea/coins/bags face-up on matching tracks; other items face-up in Satchel; return unused S items to box.
Recommended totals: at least 17 for 2 players, 18 for 3, 21 for 4. Base reach: Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3. Law allows adventurous groups any mix totaling at least 17.

Birdsong place 1 wood per sawmill in its clearing, limited by shared finite supply of 8. Daylight Overwork spends matching clearing card to place 1 wood at sawmill. Evening draw 1 plus each uncovered draw bonus, discard to 5.
Place maximum warriors available among eligible recruiters, choosing which recruiters receive them. Ordinarily one at each recruiter and Recruit once per turn.
Eyrie crafted items score 1 VP instead of printed VP under Disdain for Trade; Builder ignores Disdain. Other extra crafting-point effects still apply.

answer.ruling: Builder: Recruit, Move; ignores Disdain. Charismatic: Recruit, Battle; each Recruit places 2. Commander: Move, Battle; +1 hit as attacker. Despot: Move, Build; removing at least one enemy building/token in battle gives +1 VP beyond normal removal points.
No. Charismatic Recruit must place 2 warriors at one chosen matching roost; if only one can be placed, required action cannot be fully completed and Eyrie immediately enters Turmoil.
No bypass: warrior caps still apply. When Alliance defends it uses higher die and attacker lower.
Alliance may inspect Supporters; they may be spent only for suit, not crafting. They do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit.
No. All Revolts must be completed before beginning Spread Sympathy; once spreading starts cannot return to Revolt that Birdsong.

No. Martial Law requires at least 3 warriors of one other player in target; two players with 2 each do not meet it. Martial Law adds one matching supporter to Spread Sympathy cost; Organize has no Martial Law cost.

Placing warriors in sympathetic clearing does not trigger Outrage; moving only Vagabond pawn there does not. Moving any warriors into it does trigger, including allied warriors accompanying Vagabond; the player adds one matching hand card per affected move (or if none, shows hand and Alliance draws one).

answer.ruling: May take up to number of officers in operations, any order/repetition: Move, Battle, Recruit, Organize. Officers are not consumed. Recruit places 1 warrior at one base clearing. After operations draw 1 plus uncovered bonuses, discard to 5.
Vagabond pawn cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing all enemy pieces from its clearing instead damages 3 items.

Maximum rolled hits equals all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up or face down; exhausted swords count if undamaged. Defenseless as defender only if no undamaged swords. Hits damage one undamaged item each; excess hits ignored when none remain.

answer.ruling: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track if possible; each track holds at most 3. Exhausting a track item sends it to Satchel. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

Capacity is 6 items plus 2 per face-up bag on Bag track, counting Satchel plus Damaged box; track items do not count. Check at end of Evening; permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit. No immediate check on acquisition.

Forest Rest returns all damaged items to Satchel and flips them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. It does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Refresh flips exhausted items face up per tea then 3; Repair exhausts hammer and moves one damaged item to Satchel preserving face.

Exhaust one face-up undamaged item of any type and give a card matching clearing to a player with faction pieces there, even Hostile; may then take a crafted item from their Crafted Items if available, but none required to Aid. Non-Hostile relationship advances only when Aid that faction required number of times in same turn; each Aid counts toward one improvement.

At Allied, each subsequent Aid to faction scores 2 VP. May force warriors of one Allied faction to accompany pawn move to destination, subject to their own movement restrictions; cannot if move must be alone. At battle start as attacker, may treat one ally’s warriors there as own against another enemy, never against that ally.
At battle end, ally becomes Hostile if Vagabond removed more allied warriors than items it damaged in that battle. Equal numbers do not trigger.

answer.ruling: Cannot craft fox-and-rabbit requirement from one clearing: current clearing must match every icon. Can activate pawn repeatedly despite once-per-turn limit, exhausting one undamaged face-up hammer per icon. Crafted item may be taken face up into Satchel/track immediately and used for another Daylight action if its cost/requirements are met.

Thief starts boot, torch, tea, sword; Steal exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker starts boot, torch, bag, hammer; Day Labor exhaust torch to take discard card matching clearing (bird always qualifies). Ranger starts boot, torch, crossbow, sword; Hideout exhaust torch to repair 3 items keeping faces, immediately ends Daylight and starts Evening.
Explore removes ruin when its last hidden item is taken, freeing building slot. Ruins block slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement does not remove a ruin.
Coalition partners are not enemies; coalition does not itself grant Allied relationship powers.

Ordinary removal: 2 warriors = 0 VP; 1 building = 1 VP. Infamy: faction was non-Hostile, so first warrior that makes it Hostile gives no Infamy; second warrior gives +1 Infamy. Building removed in battle on Vagabond own turn while Hostile gives +1 ordinary removal +1 Infamy. Total = 0+0+1+1+1 = 3 VP.

answer.ruling: One boot normally. Into clearing with only hostile buildings/tokens: no extra boot. Into one or more hostile warriors: one extra boot regardless of how many hostile factions, so 2 boots total.
Taking an available dominance card puts it in hand; it does not activate. Taking and activating are separate, neither requires a Marquise action allowance.

Faction-piece ownership cannot change: each player owns chosen faction and its listed faction pieces, except items. Items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces; holding item does not make it faction-owned.

Immediate effect resolves then crafting card discarded. Persistent effect remains in play area. A card in play is outside hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.

Neither may be crafted. Defender may play matching Ambush for 2 immediate hits; attacker may play matching Ambush to foil defending ambush. Dominance may be activated to change victory condition or spent for suit.
Randomly determine starting player and seating; put score markers at 0; battle dice nearby. Faction setup order is Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond and is distinct from turn order.
First to 30 wins immediately on any player’s turn; need not finish action, phase or turn.
Choose clearing containing your warriors or pawn and an enemy player as defender. Battle does not require ruling the clearing.

Attacker chooses order of applicable before-roll effects if both sides have them, and likewise after-roll effects at same timing. Side taking hits chooses order of effects triggered by removal of its pieces.
In Count Hits, add extra hits (uncapped by warriors), then subtract ignored hits.
Corresponding item token must be in map item supply; take it from supply into crafting faction’s Crafted Items box. Usual VP is printed VP on crafting card (Eyrie instead scores 1 under Disdain).
Eyrie activates roosts; Alliance activates sympathy. Piece suit is suit of its clearing. Three-color question mark icon accepts any suit. Each piece can activate only once per turn.

Mobilize adds one hand card to Supporters; absent base max 5 and incoming overflow discarded, with any base unlimited. During Daylight Craft, Mobilize and Train may be performed in any order and number; Alliance need not finish crafting first.
Each Evening score VP on rightmost empty roost-track space; draw 1 plus uncovered draw bonuses, discard to 5. Happens after Turmoil too.
Exhaust one sword to initiate Battle. An exhausted sword cannot pay because action cost requires face-up, undamaged item, even though undamaged face-down swords count toward rolled-hit maximum.

answer.ruling: Turns proceed clockwise, each Birdsong then Daylight then Evening; after Evening next player clockwise takes turn.
For each hit choose one undamaged item; it goes to Damaged box without changing face. Already-damaged items cannot absorb hits; excess hits ignored when no undamaged items remain.
Take up to number of officers in operations, in any order/repetition. One Recruit operation places one warrior at one clearing with a base. Officers not consumed.
Daylight actions may be taken in any order and number as ready undamaged items permit; action types can be repeated.
Exhaust one crossbow to Strike. Only a face-up undamaged item can be exhausted; exhausted or damaged crossbow cannot pay.
